title: MKM compressed context payload v1
description: Agent-facing envelope when passing MKM-compressed or summarized text. Cost-aware metadata is optional in v1.

payload_kind.description: lossless_excerpt/code_reference for build-safe paths; lossy_summary for prose only.

text_effective.description: Primary string the consumer should treat as context (may be compressed or summarized).

token_estimate.description: Optional o200k or provider-specific estimate after envelope.

compression_ratio.description: Optional: compressed length / original length (same unit).

fidelity_hint.description: Optional: e.g. Jaccard reconstruction or integrity score from pipeline metrics.

tool_name.description: When kind=mcp_tool, which tool produced the payload.

warnings.description: e.g. lossy path not suitable for execution.

savings_meta.description: Optional v1 cost-aware block for agents.
